svg.title: WorthScout
svg.desc: SAAS, IN PRODUCTION. Photograph an item and get a structured resale assessment, check it against live market data, move it into inventory, prepare the listing, and pay by subscription. The source is private; the worthscout-public repo shows how it fits together. React, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Stripe. worthscout.co.uk
